text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a flower. Another key task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in a single image. These technologies have many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise road signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Doctors also use it to analyse medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in the future.
